statements.statement: The service billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The diagnosis codes submitted are I47.1 and G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms
The service is ordered to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The claim was denied because the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
